violations.text: The product segregation/warehouse room has an accumulation of clutter, soil residue and/or other debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/13/2026

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. PIC provided napkins at time of inspection. Hand-washing sink shall 6-301.12Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the toilet room. PIC placed liquid soap in toilet room at time of inspection. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026

Wood is used in the construction of (shelves) in the (kitchen and freezer) area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2026
Refrigerator and cooler 1 door gaskets were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (chlorine) sanitizing solution for the (3-bay sink). New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
The door to the toilet room located in freezer area is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
The receptacle in the toilet room is lacking a trash can and lid. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

The ceiling in the (kitchen and freezer) area is covered with material that is not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Ceilings shall be smooth, nonabsorbent, durable and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
The floors in the (kitchen and retail) area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
